aggregation: TC0-GATE (02 §14): any required row FAIL -> FAIL; else any BLOCKED -> BLOCKED; else any UNKNOWN -> UNKNOWN; else PASS (precedence accepted by the owner, 2026-10-11). A mutant killed on no program is FAIL. Every row's reasons are reported whatever the aggregate. Optional rows never satisfy a required row.

rows.acceptance: Clean worktree at a committed HEAD; every later row binds to it. A dirty tree is UNKNOWN (evidence not source-bound).
The Shen/JIT executable and library directory the gate runs on resolve to the flake's shen-jit output. No nix or no such flake output: BLOCKED. Another executable: UNKNOWN.
node --test tests/tc0/*.test.mjs: no failures. Any skipped test is UNKNOWN.
harness/hand-cases.shen: model and sandboxed implementation agree on every hand case and satisfy every hand-derived expectation; then strict replay Admitted for each.

harness/solo5-pure-call.shen on the exact-arithmetic batch: every boundary-product program agrees between the model and the Solo5 guest, whose C arithmetic is the independent side, and both guest defects are detected. Solo5 not built: BLOCKED.
harness/model-vs-candidate.shen: every program of grammar G up to 5 nodes agrees with the model run in the harness (trace and outcome), with the implementation sandboxed.
Killed (completed, trace differs from fresh Shen) on at least one exhaustive program; crashes are never kills.

Every catalog transition key covered by this run's Shen-agreeing traces; no observed step outside the catalog.
For pure-data/arm-by-position and pure-data/reverse-operands: generated discovery, typed reduction with fresh Shen confirmation, then exact original and minimized same-mutant replay.
Every boundary probe obtained in its control and denied in the sandbox. No namespace support: BLOCKED.
The ledger checker reports no problems.

A fresh S3 packet built from this run's arm-by-position report accepts the retained independent patch (campaigns/tc0/s3/independent-repair-1.patch) with DEVELOPMENT-PASS from the frozen S3 evaluator. A patch that no longer applies is UNKNOWN (stale evidence).

A reviewed record for the retained patch (matching SHA-256): either enforced isolation, or an owner waiver accepting instruction-only isolation. A waiver passes the row and is reported as a waiver in every gate report. Absent or mismatched: UNKNOWN.
